details:
Description

IDK how or why this is happening but, the blue indicator light tgat you can typically see when you pull up the quick easy menu no longer appears anymore yet it appears when you have the giant menu pop up instead. IDK if this is a quest bug or VRChat bug update but, its pretty annoying to navigate my smaller menu & i cant see what im selecting because the blue indicator line doesnt show up anymore...

Reproduction Steps

there doesnt seem to be a work around/fix to this situation. i have tried looking around my settings for a fix but, cant find one. Mind you i have NEVER tampered with my settings to begin with before this bug occured so you need to fix this
